records.Entity / project type: Bitcoin art marketplace and creator launchpad
records.Concise description: Bitcoin Ordinals art marketplace and creator platform with L1 secondary trading, auctions, drops and on-chain listing invalidation.
records.Deeper researched summary: Gamma began as a Bitcoin/Stacks NFT marketplace and launched its native Bitcoin Ordinals marketplace in March 2023. Its current Bitcoin site remains active for collections, listings, auctions and creator drops. Gamma uses wallet signatures and PSBT-style listings for Bitcoin Ordinals, but it deliberately requires an on-chain action to invalidate an Ordinal listing rather than trusting a centralized database deletion; Gamma explains this as protection against stale signed listings. Creator royalties are marketplace-enforced and configurable for future listings. Gamma's Ordinals trading settles on Bitcoin L1 rather than wrapping the inscription to another chain.
records.Launch / history: Gamma launched Ordinals creator tooling in February 2023 and its Bitcoin Ordinals marketplace on March 20, 2023. It has remained an active creator/marketplace platform through 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Gamma was one of the first polished native-Bitcoin Ordinals marketplaces and remains especially important for artist launchpads, primary drops and the design choice to invalidate signed listings on-chain.

Corroborating sources.label: On The Brink — Gamma co-founders interview

records.Verification basis: Current marketplace, support articles, launch announcement and founder interview were cross-checked.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not turn Gamma's marketing word 'trustless' into a blanket technical claim about every Gamma product. Marketplace commissions and mint-service fees differ; fee copy must identify the product and date.

records.Entity / project type: Multi-chain Web3 marketplace with substantial Bitcoin asset support
records.Concise description: OKX Web3 Wallet's marketplace implementation for Bitcoin inscriptions, BRC-20 and Runes, backed by current marketplace APIs.
records.Deeper researched summary: OKX Web3 Marketplace is part of OKX Wallet rather than the centralized OKX exchange order book. Current 2026 documentation still exposes Bitcoin marketplace APIs and workflows, including Runes collection data, listings and sales, and a create-listing endpoint that accepts a signed listing PSBT tied to a Rune-bearing UTXO. OKX Wallet itself is documented as non-custodial and seed-phrase controlled. The marketplace historically expanded beyond Ordinals/BRC-20 to Runes and other Bitcoin metaprotocol assets; current Runes APIs remain live in 2026. This record is scoped to the Bitcoin marketplace product rather than treating all of OKX as a Bitcoin-native marketplace.
Creators / founders: OKX team; this record represents the OKX Web3 Marketplace product rather than a separate founding team
records.Launch / history: OKX became a major Ordinals/BRC-20 venue in 2023 and launched Runes support with the 2024 halving. Current Runes marketplace APIs and Bitcoin wallet support remain documented in 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: OKX materially shaped Bitcoin-asset liquidity during 2023–2024 and remains a rare example of a large exchange-affiliated company maintaining a separate self-custodial Web3 marketplace stack for Bitcoin assets.
records.Verification basis: Current 2026 APIs prove active Runes marketplace support; current OKX Wallet documentation establishes wallet custody model. Historical significance is corroborated independently.
Research notes / uncertainties: One-entity rule needs Command Center attention: OKX also belongs in EXCHANGES and WALLETS. Do not infer that the centralized OKX exchange custody model applies to this Web3 Wallet marketplace, or vice versa. Zero-fee promotional claims from 2024 are historical, not timeless.

records.Concise description: Specialist peer-to-peer marketplace for rare/exotic satoshis using PSBT-based listing, offer and purchase flows.
records.Deeper researched summary: Magisat is a marketplace built around specific satoshis whose provenance or ordinal-number traits are treated as collectible. Its current guide explicitly describes Magisat as a peer-to-peer PSBT marketplace for Magic Internet Diamonds/rare sats. The API exposes seller listing PSBTs, buyer purchase PSBTs, offer creation/acceptance and UTXO-aware data; the returned structures also recognize Runes and other inscription-aware spend constraints. This makes Magisat technically distinct from general NFT marketplaces because preserving sat position and avoiding accidental spending of rare sats is core to transaction construction.
Creators / founders: Magisat team; individual founders were not established from reviewed first-party sources
records.Launch / history: Founded in the 2023 Ordinals/rare-sat wave and active through 2026 with current marketplace categories, tutorials and API v1 documentation.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Magisat is the clearest specialist venue for the rare-sat market and documents why sat-aware UTXO construction matters to trading objects that Bitcoin consensus itself does not label as 'rare.'
Related projects / entities: Rare Sats Market (derivative frontend powered by Magisat API)
records.Verification basis: Current marketplace guide, category pages and API were checked together.
Research notes / uncertainties: Rare-sat categories and labels are indexer/collector interpretations, not Bitcoin consensus state. The API supports structures involving more than rare sats, but Magisat's canonical significance remains its rare-sat specialization. Do not create a second canonical profile for RareSatsMarket.com because that site states it is powered by Magisat API.

records.Concise description: Ordinals creator launchpad with integrated minting, collection tools and marketplace functionality.
records.Deeper researched summary: Ordzaar is a Bitcoin Ordinals launchpad and marketplace oriented toward creators and collections. Its current terms explicitly define collection creation, minting tools, marketplace functionality and trading/collecting digital assets on Bitcoin, and state that Ordzaar does not store users' private keys. Current pages also show ongoing Ordinals collection-preservation initiatives. The reviewed first-party material does not expose enough low-level settlement documentation to equate the no-private-key claim with a fully specified end-to-end custody/trading architecture.
Creators / founders: Ordzaar team; individual founders were not established in reviewed first-party materials
records.Launch / history: Ordzaar emerged during the 2023 Ordinals marketplace/launchpad expansion and remains reachable with current creator and collection tooling in 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Ordzaar deserves inclusion because it has been a durable Ordinals-native creator/launchpad venue rather than a short-lived clone, with marketplace and preservation/community functions.
records.Verification basis: Current terms establish product scope and private-key handling; current pages establish ongoing platform activity.
Research notes / uncertainties: MEDIUM rather than HIGH because reviewed first-party sources do not expose precise PSBT/order-state/settlement mechanics or individual founder attribution. Do not translate 'does not store private keys' into a stronger custody claim.
